title: Close the Session, Keep the Lesson
description: Promote project truth, distill the reusable method, enqueue fast, mine in the background, and delete raw transcripts only after an explicit archive-safety receipt.
cardDesc: Turn a finished agent session into durable project truth and compact recall before its raw transcript expires.
principles: Project truth stays with the project that owns it.
Lifecycle hooks enqueue; background workers mine.
A current watermark proves ingestion, not semantic completeness.
